/* selectAtendList - Lee SangHoon */
SELECT A.SRVC_PVSN_NO AS SRVC_PVSN_NO /* 서비스제공번호 */ ,A.CASE_MNG_NO AS CASE_MNG_NO /* 사례관리번호 */ ,A.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AS CASE_MNG_ODRNO /* 사례관리차수 */ ,A.RESRCE_NO AS RESRCE_NO /* 자원번호 */
,#{ATNC_YMD} AS PTCPTN_YMD /* 참여일자 */ ,B.PROGRM_PVSN_SN AS PROGRM_PVSN_SN /* 프로그램제공일련번호 */
,NVL(B.PROGRM_CRSE_SE_CD,1) AS PROGRM_CRSE_SE_CD /* 프로그램과정구분코드 */ ,B.PROGRM_NO AS PROGRM_NO /* 프로그램번호 */ ,B.LCTRE_SN AS LCTRE_SN /* 강의일련번호 */ ,B.ATEND_TYPE_SE_CD AS ATEND_TYPE_SE_CD /* 출석유형구분코드 */ ,B.ATNC_SE_CD AS ATNC_SE_CD /* 출결구분코드 */ ,B.ATNC_CS_SE_CD AS ATNC_CS_SE_CD /* 출결사유구분코드 */ ,B.ONLINE_CLASS_YN AS ONLINE_CLASS_YN /* 온라인수업여부 */ ,B.ATFINO AS ATFINO /* 첨부파일번호 */ ,B.RM_CN AS RM_CN /* 비고내용 */ ,B.FRST_RGTR_ID AS FRST_RGTR_ID /* 최초등록자아이디 */ ,B.FRST_REG_DT AS FRST_REG_DT /* 최초등록일시 */ ,B.LAST_MDFR_ID AS LAST_MDFR_ID /* 최종수정자아이디 */ ,B.LAST_MDFCN_DT AS LAST_MDFCN_DT /* 최종수정일시 */ ,( SELECT REAL_FILE_NM FROM SAB821 WHERE ATFINO = B.ATFINO AND FILE_STTS_SE_CD = 'N' ) AS REAL_FILE_NM /* 첨부파일명 */
,DEC_B64(NVL(E.FLNM_ENCPT,C.TRPR_NM_ENCPT)) AS TRPR_NM /* 이름 */ ,NVL(E.BRTH_YMD,C.TRPR_BRTH_YMD) AS TRPR_BRTH_YMD /* 생일 */
FROM SEB500 T0 /* 서비스제공 */ JOIN SEB510 A /* 서비스제공대상자 */ ON A.SRVC_PVSN_NO = T0.SRVC_PVSN_NO AND A.RESRCE_NO = T0.RESRCE_NO AND A.DEL_YN = 'N' JOIN SDA100 F ON F.RESRCE_NO = A.RESRCE_NO LEFT JOIN SEB530 B /* 자원프로그램제공 */ ON A.SRVC_PVSN_NO = B.SRVC_PVSN_NO AND B.PTCPTN_YMD = #{ATNC_YMD} AND A.CASE_MNG_NO = B.CASE_MNG_NO AND A.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = B.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AND A.RESRCE_NO = B.RESRCE_NO AND B.PROGRM_CRSE_SE_CD = '1' JOIN SEB100 G /* 사례기본 */ ON G.CASE_MNG_NO = A.CASE_MNG_NO AND G.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = A.CASE_MNG_ODRNO JOIN SEA200 C /* 대상자정보 */ ON C.TRPR_INFO_NO = G.TRPR_INFO_NO AND C.DEL_YN = 'N' LEFT JOIN AFA330 D /* 교육이수일정내역 */ ON A.CASE_MNG_NO = D.CASE_MNG_NO AND A.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = D.CASE_MNG_ODRNO LEFT JOIN SCA300 E /* 개인정보 */ ON E.INDV_IDNTFC_NO = C.INDV_IDNTFC_NO AND E.DEL_YN = 'N'
WHERE 1=1
AND F.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO = #{SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO}
AND T0.RESRCE_NO = #{RESRCE_NO}
AND (SELECT UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD FROM SAA000 /* 통합기관 */ WHERE INST_NO = (SELECT RSFR_INST_NO FROM SDA100 /* 자원기본 */ WHERE RESRCE_NO = T0.RESRCE_NO) ) = #{UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD} AND (SELECT RSFR_INST_NO FROM SDA100 /* 자원기본 */ WHERE RESRCE_NO = T0.RESRCE_NO ) LIKE #{INST_NO} || '%' AND T0.DEL_YN = 'N' AND #{ATNC_YMD} BETWEEN NVL(NVL(D.BGNG_YMD,G.CASE_BGNG_YMD),T0.SRVC_PVSN_BGNG_YMD) AND NVL(NVL(D.END_YMD,G.CASE_TRMN_YMD),T0.SRVC_PVSN_END_YMD) AND F.SRVC_RESRCE_LCLAS_SE_CD != '01' AND #{ATNC_YMD} IN (SELECT DISTINCT AC.LCTRE_YMD FROM SDA300 AA JOIN SDA340 AB ON AB.PROGRM_NO = AA.PROGRM_NO AND AB.RESRCE_NO = AA.RESRCE_NO AND AB.DEL_YN = 'N' JOIN SDA320 AC ON AC.PROGRM_NO = AB.PROGRM_NO AND AC.RESRCE_NO = AB.RESRCE_NO AND AC.LCTRE_SN = AB.LCTRE_SN WHERE 1=1 AND AA.DEL_YN = 'N' AND AA.RESRCE_NO = T0.RESRCE_NO) AND #{INST_NO} IN ( SELECT PIC_INST_NO FROM SEB150 WHERE CASE_MNG_NO = G.CASE_MNG_NO AND CASE_MNG_ODRNO = G.CASE_MNG_ODRNO)
ORDER BY TRPR_NM

/* insertAtend - Lee SangHoon */ MERGE INTO SEB530 /* 프로그램제공 */ USING DUAL ON (SRVC_PVSN_NO = #{SRVC_PVSN_NO} /* 서비스제공번호 */ AND CASE_MNG_NO = #{CASE_MNG_NO} /* 사례관리번호 */ AND CASE_MNG_ODRNO = #{CASE_MNG_ODRNO} /* 사례관리차수 */ AND RESRCE_NO = #{RESRCE_NO} /* 자원번호 */ AND PTCPTN_YMD = #{PTCPTN_YMD} /* 참여일자 */ AND PROGRM_CRSE_SE_CD = #{PROGRM_CRSE_SE_CD}) /* 프로그램과정구분코드 */ WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET ATNC_SE_CD = #{ATNC_SE_CD} /* 출결구분코드 */ , ATNC_CS_SE_CD = #{ATNC_CS_SE_CD} /* 출결사유구분코드 */ , ATFINO = #{ATFINO} /* 첨부파일번호 */ , ONLINE_CLASS_YN = #{ONLINE_CLASS_YN} /* 온라인수업여부 */ , RM_CN = #{RM_CN} /* 비고내용 */ , LAST_MDFR_ID = #{LAST_MDFR_ID} /* 최종수정자아이디 */ , LAST_MDFCN_DT = SYSDATE /* 최종수정일시 */ WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( SRVC_PVSN_NO /* 서비스제공번호 */ , CASE_MNG_NO /* 사례관리번호 */ , CASE_MNG_ODRNO /* 사례관리차수 */ , RESRCE_NO /* 자원번호 */ , PTCPTN_YMD /* 참여일자 */ , PROGRM_PVSN_SN /* 프로그램제공일련번호 */ , PROGRM_CRSE_SE_CD /* 프로그램과정구분코드 */ , ATEND_TYPE_SE_CD /* 출석유형구분코드 */ , ATNC_SE_CD /* 출석구분코드 */ , ATNC_CS_SE_CD /* 출석사유구분코드 */ , ONLINE_CLASS_YN /* 온라인수업여부 */ , ATFINO /* 첨부파일번호 */ , RM_CN /* 비고내용 */ , FRST_RGTR_ID /* 최초등록자아이디 */ , LAST_MDFR_ID /* 최종수정자아이디 */ ) VALUES ( #{SRVC_PVSN_NO} , #{CASE_MNG_NO} , #{CASE_MNG_ODRNO} , #{RESRCE_NO} , #{PTCPTN_YMD} , (SELECT NVL(MAX(PROGRM_PVSN_SN), 0) +1 AS PROGRM_PVSN_SN FROM SEB530 WHERE 1=1 AND SRVC_PVSN_NO = #{SRVC_PVSN_NO} AND CASE_MNG_NO = #{CASE_MNG_NO} AND CASE_MNG_ODRNO = #{CASE_MNG_ODRNO} AND RESRCE_NO = #{RESRCE_NO} AND PTCPTN_YMD = #{PTCPTN_YMD}) , #{PROGRM_CRSE_SE_CD} , #{ATEND_TYPE_SE_CD} , #{ATNC_SE_CD} , #{ATNC_CS_SE_CD} , #{ONLINE_CLASS_YN} , #{ATFINO} , #{RM_CN} , #{FRST_RGTR_ID} , #{LAST_MDFR_ID} )
SELECT CASE WHEN FRST_REG_DT = LAST_MDFCN_DT THEN 'I' ELSE 'U' END AS DATAA_CHG_SE_CD FROM SEB530 WHERE SRVC_PVSN_NO = #{SRVC_PVSN_NO} /* 서비스제공번호 */ AND CASE_MNG_NO = #{CASE_MNG_NO} /* 사례관리번호 */ AND CASE_MNG_ODRNO = #{CASE_MNG_ODRNO} /* 사례관리차수 */ AND RESRCE_NO = #{RESRCE_NO} /* 자원번호 */ AND PTCPTN_YMD = #{PTCPTN_YMD} /* 참여일자 */ AND PROGRM_CRSE_SE_CD = #{PROGRM_CRSE_SE_CD} /* 프로그램과정구분코드 */

/* selectAtendByTrpr - Lee SangHoon */
SELECT BGNG_YMD -- 교육시작일 , END_YMD -- 교육종료일 , SUM(ATEND_CNT) AS ATEND_CNT -- 출석수 , SUM(ABSNC_CNT) AS ABSNC_CNT -- 결석수 , SUM(LATEN_CNT) AS LATEN_CNT -- 지각수 , SUM(LRLY_CNT) AS LRLY_CNT -- 조퇴수 , SUM(EGRS_CNT) AS EGRS_CNT -- 외출수 , SUM(ETC_CNT) AS ETC_CNT -- 기타 수 , SUM(ATEND_TIMECNT) AS ATEND_TIMECNT -- 출석시간 , SUM(CLASS_TIMECNT) AS CLASS_TIMECNT -- 총 수업시간 , SUM(ATEND_DAYCNT) AS ATEND_DAYCNT -- 출석일수 , SUM(CLASS_DAYCNT) AS CLASS_DAYCNT -- 총수업일수 FROM ( SELECT NVL(D.BGNG_YMD,C.CASE_BGNG_YMD) AS BGNG_YMD , NVL(D.END_YMD,C.CASE_TRMN_YMD) AS END_YMD , COUNT(CASE F.ATNC_SE_CD WHEN '01' THEN 1 END) AS ATEND_CNT -- 월별출석수 , COUNT(CASE F.ATNC_SE_CD WHEN '02' THEN 1 END) AS ABSNC_CNT -- 월별결석수 , COUNT(CASE F.ATNC_SE_CD WHEN '03' THEN 1 END) AS LATEN_CNT -- 월별지각수 , COUNT(CASE F.ATNC_SE_CD WHEN '04' THEN 1 END) AS LRLY_CNT -- 월별조퇴수 , COUNT(CASE F.ATNC_SE_CD WHEN '05' THEN 1 END) AS EGRS_CNT -- 월별외출수 , COUNT(CASE WHEN F.ATNC_SE_CD BETWEEN '06' AND '09' THEN 1 END) AS ETC_CNT -- 월별기타수 , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN F.ATNC_SE_CD IN ('01','03','04','05','07','08','09') THEN E.LCTRE_HR END),0) - TRUNC(COUNT(CASE WHEN F.ATNC_SE_CD IN ('03','04','05','07','08','09') THEN 1 END)/3)*MAX(LCTRE_HR) AS ATEND_TIMECNT -- 월별출석시간 , NVL(SUM(E.LCTRE_HR),0) AS CLASS_TIMECNT -- 월별총수업시간 , COUNT(CASE WHEN F.ATNC_SE_CD IN ('01','03','04','05','07','08','09') THEN 1 END) - TRUNC(COUNT(CASE WHEN F.ATNC_SE_CD IN ('03','04','05','07','08','09') THEN 1 END)/3) AS ATEND_DAYCNT --월별출석일수 , COUNT(E.LCTRE_YMD) AS CLASS_DAYCNT -- 월별총수업일수 FROM SEB510 A /* 서비스제공대상자 */ JOIN SEB500 B /* 서비스제공 */ ON B.SRVC_PVSN_NO=A.SRVC_PVSN_NO AND B.RESRCE_NO=A.RESRCE_NO JOIN SEB100 C /* 사례기본 */ ON C.CASE_MNG_NO=A.CASE_MNG_NO AND C.CASE_MNG_ODRNO=A.CASE_MNG_ODRNO LEFT JOIN AFA330 D /* 교육이수일정내역 */ ON D.CASE_MNG_NO=C.CASE_MNG_NO AND D.CASE_MNG_ODRNO=C.CASE_MNG_ODRNO LEFT JOIN ( SELECT E1.RESRCE_NO , E3.LCTRE_YMD , SUM(E3.LCTRE_HR) AS LCTRE_HR FROM SDA300 E1 /*자원프로그램*/ JOIN SDA340 E2 /*자원프로그램상세일정*/ ON E2.PROGRM_NO =E1.PROGRM_NO AND E2.RESRCE_NO=E1.RESRCE_NO AND E2.DEL_YN='N' JOIN SDA320 E3 /*자원프로그램실행시간*/ ON E3.PROGRM_NO =E2.PROGRM_NO AND E3.RESRCE_NO=E2.RESRCE_NO AND E3.LCTRE_SN=E2.LCTRE_SN WHERE E1.DEL_YN ='N' GROUP BY E1.RESRCE_NO, E3.LCTRE_YMD ) E ON E.RESRCE_NO= A.RESRCE_NO AND E.LCTRE_YMD BETWEEN NVL(NVL(D.BGNG_YMD,C.CASE_BGNG_YMD),B.SRVC_PVSN_BGNG_YMD) AND NVL(NVL(D.END_YMD,C.CASE_TRMN_YMD),B.SRVC_PVSN_END_YMD) LEFT JOIN SEB530 F /* 자원프로그렘제공 */ ON F.SRVC_PVSN_NO=A.SRVC_PVSN_NO AND F.CASE_MNG_NO=A.CASE_MNG_NO AND F.CASE_MNG_ODRNO=A.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AND F.RESRCE_NO=A.RESRCE_NO AND F.PTCPTN_YMD=E.LCTRE_YMD AND F.PROGRM_CRSE_SE_CD ='1' WHERE 1=1 AND A.SRVC_PVSN_NO=#{SRVC_PVSN_NO} AND A.CASE_MNG_NO=#{CASE_MNG_NO} AND A.CASE_MNG_ODRNO=#{CASE_MNG_ODRNO} AND A.RESRCE_NO=#{RESRCE_NO} AND A.DEL_YN='N' AND B.DEL_YN='N' GROUP BY NVL(D.BGNG_YMD,C.CASE_BGNG_YMD) , NVL(D.END_YMD,C.CASE_TRMN_YMD) , A.SRVC_PVSN_NO , A.CASE_MNG_NO , A.CASE_MNG_ODRNO , A.RESRCE_NO , SUBSTR(E.LCTRE_YMD,1,6) ) GROUP BY BGNG_YMD, END_YMD
